intro: A 500ml bottle of isotonic drink is about 130 kcal (estimate). Almost all of it comes from sugar, roughly 8 teaspoons.
diet: Yes, but most people don't actually need it. For office days or light exercise under an hour, plain water is enough. Isotonic drinks make more sense when you sweat a lot, like playing futsal or running long in the heat. If you drink it like normal water, the sugar calories add up fast.
tips: Save it for heavy exercise or very hot weather only.
Choose the zero or low sugar version if you like the taste.
Drink half the bottle, then continue with plain water.

swap.name: Young coconut water, no sugar (1 glass)
swap.why: Refreshing, naturally has minerals like potassium, and much lower in calories.

faq.q: Do I need an isotonic drink after the gym?
faq.a: For a normal gym session of about an hour, plain water is usually enough. Isotonic drinks are more useful when you sweat a lot for a long time.

faq.q: Is an isotonic drink okay when I have a fever or diarrhoea?
faq.a: Many people drink it to replace fluids. But for health issues, it's best to follow your doctor's or pharmacist's advice.

faq.q: What's the difference between isotonic and energy drinks?
faq.a: Isotonic drinks focus on sugar and electrolytes to replace fluids. Energy drinks usually have caffeine and other stimulants.
